about.title: About us
about.subtitle: An Egyptian travel company running day trips and multi-day journeys across Egypt.
about.story: We started with a single trip and a small group of friends. Today we run regular journeys to Egypt's most rewarding destinations. What hasn't changed is the method: plan every detail in advance, choose comfortable transport, and leave our guests free to enjoy the place instead of worrying about logistics.

comfort.title: Comfort first
comfort.body: Air-conditioned vehicles, realistic timings, and proper rest stops.

tripForm.newDescription: Fill in at least a title, destination, dates, price and capacity. You can publish it once a cover image is set.

content.title: Content
content.description: Both languages are shown to visitors; each field falls back to the other language when one is empty.

visibility.title: Visibility
visibility.description: Upcoming, ongoing and completed follow the trip's dates automatically. Choose Draft or Cancelled only to override that.

fields.title: Title
fields.slugHintWithValue: The trip will live at /ar/trips/{slug} and /en/trips/{slug}
fields.slugHintSuggested: Leave blank to generate "{slug}" from the title.
fields.slugHintEmpty: Leave blank to generate one from the title.
fields.locationHint: The specific sites visited, shown beside the destination.
fields.shortDescriptionHint: One or two sentences. Used on trip cards and in search results.
fields.reservationsOpenHint: Optional. Leave blank to accept reservations immediately.
fields.reservationsCloseHint: Optional. Leave blank to keep them open until departure.
fields.availableSeatsHint: Seats still open. Cannot exceed the capacity.
fields.reservationInfoHint: How to reserve, deposits, and any conditions.
fields.displayOrderHint: Lower numbers appear first among featured trips.
fields.publishedHint: Visible on the public site. Requires a cover image.

tripForm.genericError: Could not save the trip. Please try again.

imageManager.coverHint: Shown on trip cards and at the top of the trip page. Required before the trip can be published. JPG, PNG, WebP or AVIF, up to 8 MB.
imageManager.galleryHint: Photographs shown on the trip page and in the homepage strip. Drag order is set with the arrows; the first image appears first.
imageManager.uploadFailed: The upload failed. Please try again.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Company details, WhatsApp and contact information. Changes appear on the site immediately.

whatsapp.title: WhatsApp
whatsapp.description: The number behind the floating button and every reservation call to action.

seo.title: Search engine listing
seo.description: Optional overrides for the homepage title and description. Leave blank to use the built-in copy.

fields.taglineHint: Shown under the logo in the header and above the hero headline.
fields.aboutHint: Used in the footer and as the story on the About page.
fields.whatsappNumberHint: Include the country code, e.g. +20 101 275 2911. Leave blank to hide the button entirely.
fields.whatsappMessageHint: What the visitor's chat opens with. Trip pages append the trip name automatically.
fields.mapUrlHint: Optional. A Google Maps URL; the address links to it on the contact page.

settings.savedNotice: Settings saved. They are live on the site now.
settings.genericError: Could not save the settings. Please try again.
